title: Loop Builder
summary: Turn a loosely described task into a controllable Agent Loop with evidence gates, feedback signals, stopping rules, and explicit human decisions.
user_needs: decide whether a task should become an Agent Loop
turn a rough task into a reusable Codex prompt or Loop package
define feedback signals, iteration limits, and circuit breakers
preserve human approval for risky or irreversible actions
model a reusable Loop Agent or Skill before generating it
